# Partner Goods Request — Google Form parity checklist

**Generated by `npm run build:pdf` from `src/lib/partnerRequest.ts` — do not edit by hand.**
After ANY edit to the Google Form behind /request, compare the live respondent view
(https://childrenscollectivefl.org/request) against this table. Every wording and
required flag must match. The PDF is regenerated from the same module, so if this
file is current, the PDF matches too.

**Form title:** Children's Collective Partner Goods Request
**Form settings:** collect email addresses ON · send responders a copy of their response: Always · new-response email notifications ON.

| Question | Type | Required | Where | Options | Helper text |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Email | Short answer (the form's collect-email setting; placeholder reads Your email) | REQUIRED | Form + PDF |  |  |
| Requesting organization name | Short answer | REQUIRED | Form + PDF |  |  |
| Your name and title | Short answer | REQUIRED | Form + PDF |  |  |
| Your phone | Short answer | REQUIRED | Form + PDF |  |  |
| Approved by (name and title) | Short answer | optional | Form + PDF |  | The supervisor or program lead at your organization who approved this request. Enter your own name if you are the approver. |
| Date of request | Short answer | REQUIRED | PDF only (paper) |  |  |
| Who is this request for? | Multiple choice | REQUIRED | Form + PDF | "Children in our care" · "A caregiver or family our team supports (kinship, foster, adoptive, reunifying, or crisis), including families referred to us by another organization" |  |
| How urgent is this request? | Multiple choice | REQUIRED | Form + PDF | "Emergency: needed within 48 hours" · "Needed this week" · "Standard: within 2 weeks" · "Bulk request: building your location's supply or another large need" |  |
| Number of children this request serves | Short answer | REQUIRED | Form + PDF |  | How many children will receive items from this request? This is for this request only, not your total number of children in care. For a caregiver request, count the children in the households it will serve. |
| Item categories | Checkboxes | REQUIRED | Form + PDF | "Standard duffel bag" · "Pull-ups or diapers in place of underwear" · "Hygiene products, as available" · "Specific items only (not a full bag)" · "Other needs (describe in the child details below)" | Every Children's Collective duffel bag includes 4 tops, 4 bottoms, pajamas, gently used shoes, new socks, new underwear, and a special toy or book. We substitute one pack of pull-ups or diapers for underwear when needed. Hygiene products vary with inventory and supply at the time of the request. |
| Child details: gender, age, clothing size, shoe size, special requests or restrictions | Paragraph | REQUIRED | Form + PDF |  | List each child on its own line, then add any special requests or restrictions (substitutions that are OK, preferences, special needs). Please do not include names. If you know it, include fit as you'd see it on a store label: slim/petite, regular, plus/husky, or tall. Example: Child 1: girl, age 7, clothing size 8 (slim fit), shoe size 2. Prefers leggings. Child 2: boy, age 14, men's M (husky fit), shoe size 9. Substitutions OK.  Need something beyond the standard bag, such as a coat or a car seat? Tell us here. |
| Bulk request only: briefly describe what you need | Paragraph | optional | Form + PDF |  | Only if you chose Bulk request above. A few sentences is plenty, for example what you are stocking and roughly how many children or sizes. Our team will reach out to talk through details. |
| Delivery or pickup | Multiple choice | REQUIRED | Form + PDF | "The Children's Collective delivers to our office" · "We will pick up (we'll arrange a time and place with you)" |  |
| Delivery address (your office, not a family's home) | Paragraph | optional | Form + PDF |  |  |
| On-site contact and best delivery times | Short answer | optional | Form + PDF |  |  |
| Delivery instructions (check-in, parking, visitor requirements) | Paragraph | optional | Form + PDF |  |  |
| Please confirm | Checkboxes | REQUIRED | Form + PDF | "This request contains no names or identifying details about any child or family." · "This request is approved by my organization, and items will go to the children or caregivers we serve." |  |

**Item categories note:** the paper form's last option reads "Other needs (describe in the notes below)" (its notes live in the child blocks); the Google Form's reads "Other needs (describe in the child details below)". Approved structural variance, founder 2026-11-01.

**Confirmation message (after submit):**
> Thank you. Your request has been received. The Children's Collective of Florida will contact you within one business day to confirm this request and to schedule delivery. A copy of your responses is on its way to your email. Prefer to email? Please email info@childrenscollectiveFL.org.

**Form description must carry:** the duffel-standard sentence, partner-organizations-only eligibility with the /partner-apply link, the age-gender-size privacy line, the email option ("Prefer to email? Please email info@childrenscollectiveFL.org") as the last line before the tagline, and zero bare instances of the organizational acronym anywhere on the form (title included).
